subject: Botany

(1) \( C_2H_4 \) promotes leaf senescence.
(2) \( C_2H_4 \) speeds the ripening of fruits.
(3) \( C_2H_4 \) causes apical hook formation.
(4) \( C_2H_4 \) promotes horizontal growth of seedling and swelling of axis.
(5) \( C_2H_4 \) promotes male flowers in cucumber thereby increasing the yield.
reasoning: Ethylene promotes FEMALE flowers in cucurbits (cucumber), increasing yield — so statement (5) is false. Statements (1)-(4) are all correct (senescence, ripening, apical hook, triple response). Only (5) is false → option (d). Derived; no key printed.

subject: Botany
stem:
The glycolytic pathway has an investment of 2 ATP molecules. At which of the following steps is the debt paid off?

| # | Step |
|---|---|
| 1. | Conversion of Glucose into Glucose-6-phosphate |
| 2. | Conversion of Fructose-6-phosphate into Fructose 1,6-biphosphate |
| 3. | Conversion of 1,3 biphosphoglyceric acid into 3-phosphoglyceric acid |
| 4. | Conversion of Phosphoenol pyruvate into Pyruvic acid |
options: Conversion of 1,3 biphosphoglyceric acid into 3-phosphoglyceric acid
Conversion of Phosphoenol pyruvate into Pyruvic acid
reasoning: The first substrate-level ATP is produced at 1,3-BPG → 3-PGA (step 3), where the 2-ATP investment begins to be repaid. Answer = 3 (C). Preserved source spelling 'biphosphate/biphosphoglyceric'. Derived; no key printed.

subject: Botany
stem:
Match the components of the Electron Transport System (ETS) with their respective functions:

| Column I (ETS Component) | Column II (Function) |
|---|---|
| A. Complex I (NADH dehydrogenase) | 1. Transfers electrons to \( O_2 \), leading to \( H_2O \) formation |
| B. Complex II (Succinate dehydrogenase) | 2. Transfers electrons from NADH to ubiquinone |
| C. Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q) | 3. Receives electrons from both Complex I and II, and transfers them to Complex III |
| D. Complex III (Cytochrome \( bc_1 \) complex) | 4. Transfers electrons from ubiquinone to cytochrome c |
| E. Cytochrome c | 5. Acts as a mobile carrier between Complex III and Complex IV |
| F. Complex IV (Cytochrome c oxidase) | 6. Transfers electrons from \( FADH_2 \) to ubiquinone |
reasoning: A(Complex I)→2 (NADH→UQ); B(Complex II)→6 (FADH2→UQ); C(Ubiquinone)→3 (receives from I & II); D(Complex III)→4 (UQ→cyt c); E(Cyt c)→5 (mobile carrier III–IV); F(Complex IV)→1 (→O2/H2O). Matches option 4 (D). Derived; no key printed.
